detail.longDescription:
HHS has decided to fund a clinical trial of ibogaine, a weird drug from West Africa that has a very unusual and intriguing ability to interrupt opiate addiction and reset tolerance. I wrote about it 20+ years ago and was working on a book I never finished, but I got to know a bunch of interesting people in the underground ibogaine scene. It's illegal in the US but people were using it in NYC and elsewhere. There are 'clinics' in Mexico & Costa Rica (usually rental houses with some kind of minimal medical oversight). It has a problem with cardiac toxcity and also tends to send people on unpleasant 12-hour trips. I met one person who liked it.  

There was a phase 1 trial in 1993 but someone died in St. Kitt's, where a Florida professor was running the trial. The volunteer took ibogaine & then went back to their old dose of opiates...but because it resets tolerance, they ODed. No federal human research on it since then. 

#addiction #research #medicine
